subject: Quick thought on the Doc B's Austin site + a live preview
body: Hi Doc B's Austin Team, I love stopping by for your scratch-made burgers and weekend brunch, so I spent some time looking over your Austin location page. While your daily ingredients and vibrant atmosphere shine through, I noticed that adding a more prominent 'Reserve a Table' button to the top navigation would make it easier for local diners to book on mobile devices, and deeper content on the page could improve local search visibility. I went ahead and put together a modern, live prototype for you that addresses these exact points with a clean layout and an immediate reservation CTA. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644cc729a302889-0x2455f0aa5c20fb8-3wmtoca38.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a prominent 'Reserve a Table' button to the top navigation bar
Expanded local content for better search engine visibility
